fields.name: organism
fields.note: The organism to profile. Common name or scientific name (e.g. 'Homo sapiens', 'king cobra', 'Arabidopsis thaliana').

fields.name: focus
fields.note: Optional. Specific aspect to emphasise: 'phylogeny', 'genome', 'conservation', or 'all' (default). Narrows which NCBI / GBIF tool calls are prioritised.

fields.name: context
fields.note: Optional. Research context or specific questions to address (e.g. 'compare to Arabidopsis lyrata for synteny analysis').
